name: Reinet Investments S.C.A.
source: Yahoo Finance | CRON 2026-11-16 open item, income tax left blank deliberately: Reinet Investments is an investment entity under IFRS 10, so its consolidated financial statements carry no IFRS income statement with a taxation line. The only presentation of an income statement is the non-IFRS table in the business overview (Annual Report 2025, page 25, 'Income statement ... not prepared under IFRS rules'), which shows 'Tax expense (2)' for FY2025 and '(1)' for FY2024 inside total expenses, and prints net profit 797 and 519 against the 795 and 519 stored here. Writing that 2 into Income Tax while Profit Before Tax stays 795 would break Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit, and the amounts are inside a non-IFRS presentation, so the three cells disagree and none is overwritten. This label is not part of the issuer's statutory statement and the dash is the honest state. Sources read: https://www.reinet.com/images/investor_relations/reports/annual_report/2025/ar2025_m28fdzc638d9wjs72hs7h2.pdf and the JSE copy https://senspdf.jse.co.za/documents/2026/JSE/ISSE/RNIE/ARMar26.pdf
